items.distractor_fact: Ένας γείτονας σημείωσε στο δικό του θερμόμετρο {D}°C το ίδιο βράδυ.
items.gloss_en: A neighbor recorded {D}°C on his own thermometer the same evening.
items.entity_note: belongs to a neighbor's private thermometer, a person, not the village recording station (a place) of the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ο χρηματομεσίτης του πελάτη ανέφερε τιμή {D} ευρώ για μια άλλη μετοχή του χαρτοφυλακίου του την ίδια συνεδρίαση.
items.gloss_en: The client's broker reported a price of {D} euros for another stock in his portfolio during the same session.
items.entity_note: belongs to a client's individual portfolio holding, a person, not another company's stock (an organization) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Σε ιδιωτικό πηγάδι κοντινού αγρότη η στάθμη του νερού σήμερα ήταν {D} μέτρα.
items.gloss_en: In a nearby farmer's private well, the water level today was {D} meters.
items.entity_note: belongs to a farmer's private well, a person's property, not another reservoir (a place) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας ερασιτέχνης παρατηρητής κατέγραψε με το δικό του υψόμετρο {D} μέτρα την ίδια στιγμή.
items.gloss_en: An amateur observer recorded {D} meters on his own altimeter at the same moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a bystander's personal altimeter, a person, not another drone (an instrument) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας τοπικός συνεταιρισμός είχε στο ταμείο του {D} ευρώ την ίδια περίοδο.
items.gloss_en: A local cooperative had {D} euros in its treasury during the same period.
items.entity_note: belongs to a cooperative's treasury, an organization, not another individual bank account as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας ελεύθερος επαγγελματίας του ίδιου κλάδου είχε δαπάνες {D} ευρώ τον ίδιο μήνα.
items.gloss_en: A freelancer in the same field had expenses of {D} euros in the same month.
items.entity_note: belongs to a self-employed individual, a person, not another business (an organization) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας παίκτης άλλης ομάδας σκόραρε {D} γκολ στην ίδια σεζόν.
items.gloss_en: A player from another team scored {D} goals in the same season.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual player, a person, not another team (an organization) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένα αμοιβαίο κεφάλαιο της ίδιας αγοράς είχε ζημίες {D} ευρώ την ίδια χρονιά.
items.gloss_en: A mutual fund in the same market had losses of {D} euros in the same year.
items.entity_note: belongs to a mutual fund, an organization, not another individual investor (a person) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας ανεξάρτητος εργολάβος παρήγαγε {D} μονάδες τον ίδιο μήνα, χωρίς δικό του καθορισμένο στόχο.
items.gloss_en: An independent contractor produced {D} units in the same month, with no target of his own set.
items.entity_note: belongs to an independent contractor, a person, not another factory (an organization); his own target is explicitly unstated, so no second deviation is completable

items.distractor_fact: Ένα συνεργαζόμενο κατάστημα της αλυσίδας πραγματοποίησε πωλήσεις {D} ευρώ τον ίδιο μήνα, για το οποίο δεν αναφέρεται στόχος.
items.gloss_en: A partner store of the chain made sales of {D} euros in the same month, for which no target is stated.
items.entity_note: belongs to a partner store, an organization, not another salesperson (a person) as in the first sentence; its own target is explicitly unstated

items.distractor_fact: Ένας αγρότης κατέγραψε στο δικό του μετρητή βροχής {D} χιλιοστά τον ίδιο μήνα, χωρίς επίσημη πρόβλεψη γι' αυτόν.
items.gloss_en: A farmer recorded {D} millimeters on his own rain gauge in the same month, with no official forecast for it.
items.entity_note: belongs to a farmer's private rain gauge, a person, not another nearby area (a place) as in the first sentence; no forecast is stated for it

items.distractor_fact: Ένα λεωφορείο διαφορετικής εταιρείας έφτασε στον ίδιο σταθμό τη χρονική στιγμή {D} λεπτών, μετρημένη από δική του αφετηρία.
items.gloss_en: A bus from a different company arrived at the same station at the moment {D} minutes, measured from its own reference point.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different transport company's bus, an organization, not another line's train (a vehicle) as in the first sentence; measured against its own reference

items.distractor_fact: Ένας γείτονας σταθμεύει το μηχανάκι του σε άλλο κτίριο, σε θέση με κωδικό ορόφου {D}, όπου δεν δηλώνεται κωδικός εισόδου.
items.gloss_en: A neighbor parks his moped in a different building, in a spot with floor code {D}, where no entrance code is stated.
items.entity_note: belongs to a neighbor, a person, not another garage (a place) as in the first sentence; no entrance-code reference is stated there

items.distractor_fact: Ο κορυφαίος σκόρερ ενός τρίτου συλλόγου σκόραρε {D} γκολ στο ίδιο πρωτάθλημα.
items.gloss_en: The top scorer of a third club scored {D} goals in the same championship.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual player, a person, not a third team Ω (an organization) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας επιχειρηματίας εκτός των δύο εταιρειών είχε έσοδα {D} χιλιάδες ευρώ φέτος.
items.gloss_en: A businessperson outside the two companies had revenue of {D} thousand euros this year.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual businessperson, a person, not company Γ (an organization) as in the first sentence

items.distractor_fact: Ένας ορειβάτης κατέγραψε με το δικό του υψόμετρο {D} μέτρα σε άλλη οροσειρά την ίδια εποχή.
items.gloss_en: A mountaineer recorded {D} meters with his own altimeter in a different mountain range that same season.
items.entity_note: belongs to a mountaineer, a person, not peak Γ (a place) as in the first sentence
